lines: We have commenced Project RAT. We aim to add rats as a new branch of [SURVEILLANCE SYSTEM]. The rats live in a 10 cm x 10 cm cage. We nourish them via IV. They do not require exercise. We have administered [SEDATIVE DRUG] to the rats and implanted [IMPLANT] to connect it with [SURVEILLANCE SYSTEM].
I have been tasked with checking on the rats every hour. The task, although dull, has been proceeding smoothly.
But I have observed an odd behavior in RAT-8. Whenever I look at it, it backs into a corner and covers its face, like a shy school-girl. The other rats follow suit.
We will have to investigate further.</size>
